lines: İstanbul'un siluetinde yedi yüz yıllık bir kule durur.
Galata Kulesi, bin üç yüz kırk sekizde Cenevizliler tarafından tamamlandı.
Osmanlı döneminde yangın gözetleme kulesi oldu.
Rivayete göre on yedinci yüzyılda Hezarfen Ahmet Çelebi buradan Üsküdar'a uçtu.
Kule, yüzyıllar içinde yangın ve depremlerden sonra yeniden yapıldı.
Bugün yaklaşık altmış yedi metre yüksekliğiyle şehrin simgelerinden biri.
Ve hâlâ, Haliç'e yukarıdan bakan aynı pencereler orada.

acts.why: the medieval tower: studied like an old print, a rostrum camera over paper
Ottoman centuries as a case file: finds dropped on a board, a typed legend, fires and quakes pinned together
back to today: a loud poster, the number and the view

ideas: Seven hundred years stamped across the skyline with the tower behind
A timeline whose playhead stops on 1348, the Genoese year
The old panorama; the camera dives to the tower and an arrow names it the Tower of Christ
A polaroid of the tower's gallery dropped on the file: the fire watch
The legend typed on a file card, marked as a tale and credited to the traveller who told it
A cork board: the tower's damaged and rebuilt states pinned and joined by a red string
Sixty-seven metres rolling up like an odometer over the tower
The view from the windows across the water, drifting, the last words huge
